Add GitHub Action for Bash script linting

- Created a new GitHub Action (bash-check.yml) to automatically lint Bash scripts using shellcheck.
- Configured the Action to run on every push and pull request to the main branch.
- Ensures code quality by detecting syntax errors and best practice violations in Bash scripts.
- Helps maintain clean and error-free scripts for better project management.

Created a README.md file for the automation-scripts repository:
- Includes an overview of each script (backup.sh, monitor.sh, update_system.sh).

Add system update script with email log notification

Implemented a Bash script (update_system.sh) for updating Linux packages:
- Runs apt-get update and upgrade commands to keep the system up-to-date.
- Logs output to a temporary file.
- Sends the update log to a specified email address using the mail command.
- Designed for systems with configured email services.

Add system monitoring script for CPU, memory, and disk usage

Developed a Bash script (monitor.sh) to monitor system resources:
- Displays CPU usage as a percentage using the top command and awk.
- Shows memory usage in a human-readable format.
- Lists disk usage for mounted drives.
- Aimed to provide a quick overview of system performance.

Add backup script for directory compression

Created a Bash script (backup.sh) to automate the backup process for specified directories.
- Compresses the target directory into a tar.gz file with a date-based filename.
- Ensures the backup directory exists before saving the file.
- Displays a completion message with the backup file path.
